title: “La Grande Vadrouille”
text: In 1966 Bourvil and Louis de Funès starred in “La Grande Vadrouille”. More than 17 million tickets were sold, a record in France for decades.

title: Polnareff: “La Poupée qui fait non”
text: In 1966 Michel Polnareff had his first hit with “La Poupée qui fait non”.

title: Dutronc: “Et moi, et moi, et moi”
text: In 1966 Jacques Dutronc sang “Et moi, et moi, et moi”, a wry song about thinking of oneself in a world of millions.
